approver mandate, and costs both budgets
D-62, D-71, D-73

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

CLOSED — challenge purpose is binding.
A second passkey needs a grant
D-66, D-67

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

CLOSED — merchant trust is per identifier.
The directory is exact-match
D-69, D-70

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

CLOSED — the asset registry owns decimals
D-68

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — a replay returns the original.
A unique index decides the race
D-74

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — ledger rows carry the window

D-72

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

CLOSED — HMAC signature checked
on every rail webhook
D-32

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — no model is ever in the
authorization path, and the compiler
asks rather than inventing a limit
non-negotiable 1 and 8

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — the fetched URL is policy-checked
and the connection pinned to the
address that was validated
D-75

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — decision, hold and evidence event
are one transaction
D-76, D-90

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — an agent reaches only its own
authorizations, and never chooses
the instrument at execution
D-78

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — an increment is a new decision
on the delta; the ceiling is checked
against the aggregate
D-79

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — the whole card lifecycle:
reversal and expiry release, a capture
records what SETTLED, a refund total
credits only the delta
D-81, D-82, D-83

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — a purpose per operation.
A policy signature cannot mint
an enrolment grant
D-86

div.style: color: rgb(20, 50, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
CLOSED — a nonzero transfer is never $0.00,
and max_count keeps counting
a payment after it settles
D-87, D-88

div.style: color: rgb(12, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
PARTIAL — the chain is signed
and hash-linked, and every decision
is now in it
D-26, D-53, D-90

div.style: color: rgb(12, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
PARTIAL — a force capture or overcapture
cannot be declined, because nobody asks.
It is charged against the cap and flagged
with what the engine WOULD have decided
D-84

div.style: color: rgb(12, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
PARTIAL — the principal signs one
policy hash, so an injected policy
still needs a human ceremony
D-20

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
OPEN — the co-signer key alone completes
any session-signed transaction.
A Safe Guard is named, not built
D-56, D-59

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
OPEN — the chain has no external anchor,
so completeness is unprovable
OQ-8

span.p:
OPEN — on x402, VERIFIED means the host
asked, not that it is who it claims
OQ-13

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
OPEN — DB write access mints credentials
and biases the spend SUM
D-54, no test

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
OPEN — a packages/core dependency
can alter evaluate() itself
D-43, no test

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OPEN — no kill switch for the
Safe co-signer key
D-58

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
OPEN — an org credential can enrol a
principal's FIRST passkey and activate a
mandate unaided. D-66's grant covers
only a second one

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
OPEN — the principal reads a summary,
not the policy hash. Nothing proves the
human understood what they signed

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
OPEN — a step-up EXPIRY releases a
reservation with nothing in the
signed chain to say so
OQ-14

div.style: color: rgb(74, 34, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 230px; text-align: center; width: 230px;

span.p:
OPEN — no rate limiter on any route.
A leaked key is bounded by policy,
never by volume
